name: Saudi Post (SPL)
note: Saudi Arabia's national postal and logistics operator (est. 1926). Official Logistics Partner of Diriyah Club on a three-season agreement signed 18 Aug 2026. Owner not yet sourced: SPL's own About page (splonline.com.sa/en/about/) says Saudi Post was established in 1926, launched SPL as part of a transformation initiated by Royal Decree No. 52631 (2017), and that the Ministry of Transport and Logistics Services oversees the postal sector under Council of Ministers Resolution No. 705 — sector oversight, not a named shareholding owner; the club/SPL partnership announcements do not state who owns the corporation, and the SPL annual report PDF carries no extractable ownership text.
